newsitem.title: UK: BA shares drop as results disappoint.
newsitem.headline: BA shares drop as results disappoint.

text.p: British Airways Plc shares fell four percent in early trade on Monday after disappointing results from the UK flag carrier, dealers and analysts said.
The stock was first quoted down 26p at 614 at 0726 GMT in volume of 361,482 shares.
"The results just look a little disappointing," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
BA posted a 46.7 percent rise in first-quarter pre-tax profit to 220 million stg, yet that total was boosted by a 130 million stg gain on the sale of its US Airways stake.

The underlying result fell short of analyst expectations, which had ranged mostly between 115 million stg and 151 million. BA said the strength of sterling had taken a 77 million chunk out of its profits.

The company said regulatory approval of its proposed alliance with American Airlines was proceeding very slowly and it was continuing to have talks with the UK Office of Fair Trading, the European Union's Competition Directorate and the U.S. Department of Justice.

It said the general business environment, including the start of a recovery in continental Europe, favoured growth in international air traffic though sterling strength would continue to depress profits.
